signed_native_worker_inference.meaning: All seven produced a final result for the same 10 unique recorded Chinese clips. 70/70 direct inference runs.

native_panel_while_speaking.meaning: AppKit laid out multiple reference-bearing updates in all 7 clips >=10s per live-capable engine (28/28). 40/40 panel receipts for 10 clips per engine. Qwen 0.6B is chunked, not a true online decoder.

chunked_first_visible_p95_goal.meaning: Qwen 0.6B first visible lexical P95 3.54s > 2s. Its P50 was within the 1s target. No adjustment to discard slow starts.

streaming_first_visible_target.meaning: Apple, sherpa and Nemotron first lexical glyph each had P50 <=1s and P95 <=2s on this 10-clip cohort; first reference bigram is stricter and reported separately.

batch_never_advertised_as_live.meaning: Three archive-only families produced exactly zero pre-EOS native updates and returned a retained revision in the one-file native trial.

original_batch_probe_on_extra_vad_row.meaning: A single-file engineering probe waits when a VAD row terminates without text; the additional independent normal archive actions preserve this failure and continue.

model_download_pause_resume_integrity.meaning: Real HTTPS pause/resume/hash, restart and delete, plus same-size corruption rejected and original audio saved. Download-manager source unchanged from the measured network run.

model_lifecycle_and_selection.meaning: Switched at 5s with on-screen text. One provider per utterance. Real worker exits during idle and reloads for the next utterance.

application_replacement_and_rollback.meaning: Disposable installation, launch, schema-6 archive, drafts, audio, test Keychain, authorizations and 237202501 bytes of model weights remained intact.

window_recording.meaning: 14.94 s real per-window H.264, one video track / no audio, no desktop capture.

whole_machine_power_observed.meaning: Seven paired session/idle windows with total watts and CPU/GPU/ANE power plus GPU activity. Not app-attributed wattage.

per_process_gpu_ane_utilization.meaning: Per-process GPU/ANE occupancy and Apple shared service memory are not independently exposed by the available counters. Do not report zero as an occupancy measurement.

apple_asset_transfer_accounting.meaning: Apple manages speech resources. Active package mapping, exact download seconds and bytes for just this app are not observable.

public_distribution.meaning: Developer ID signed and timestamped, not notarized; normal Gatekeeper assessment rejected.

live_cloud_gpt6_and_paid_asr.meaning: No authorized paid inference invoked. Local system delivers previews and writes audio without any cloud account.

physical_microphone_and_overnight.meaning: Paced corpus through production ring/VAD rather than physical transducer or private live conversation. One 30-minute sherpa soak; no new all-model overnight, sleep or battery-life claims.

sensevoice_commercial_distribution.meaning: Evaluation only; retains upstream FunASR model terms. Commercial distribution scope not cleared.
